<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 19:29">Ib. XIX, 29</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 20:6">XX, 6</cite> (v. Ar. ed. Koh. s. v.); a. e.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38b">Ab. Zar. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>דילמא הַדּוּמֵי הַדְּמוּהָ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>אדמויי אַדְּמוּהָ</he>, read <cite ref="A00384"><he>אַדּוּמֵי</he></cite>) perhaps they carved the bird and then put it into the pot.
<cite ref="Eruvin 30a:4">Erub. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>הַדּוּמֵי נִיהַדְּמֵיה</he> shall we cut him apart?—
Bets. 24ᵇ דאַדִּימֵי (ed. Sonc. a. Ven. דהַדִּימֵי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) fish that were dissected (Rashi: red, v. אֲדִימָּא).

senses.gloss: אֲהַדֵּם (denom. of next w.) to arrange the parts of an animal.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 67b:20">Gitt. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲהַדְּמוּ לי הַדָּמֵי דחיותא</he> arrange before me the limbs of the (dissected) animal.
